claim: Cancale's Marché aux Huîtres operates daily with 8 independent producers; spring/summer hours 9am-7pm (8pm in July-August), autumn/winter 9-9:30am to 5:30pm, located at Rue des Parcs - Le Port near Pointe des Crolles.
quote: Spring/Summer: Daily: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM, Extended to 8:00 PM in July-August. The market features 8 independent oyster producers. Rue des Parcs - Le Port, 35260 Cancale

claim: A dozen huîtres creuses at the Cancale market costs roughly 6-10€ (caliber 3 around 6-8€, smaller calibers up to 7.50€), with flat oysters (Belon) and special selections like Tsarskaya priced higher.
quote: la douzaine d'huîtres se vend entre 6 et 10 euros... La douzaine d'huîtres creuses calibre n°3 se vend entre 6 et 8 €... pour des produits d'exception comme les huîtres plates (Belon) ou des sélections spéciales (Tsarskaya), les prix s'ajustent à la rareté

claim: The GR34 coastal hike from Cancale to Pointe du Grouin runs about 7 km one-way along clifftop paths, taking roughly 3 hours with moderate up-and-down terrain.
quote: GR®34 Cancale – Pointe du Grouin, Ille-et-Vilaine, France

claim: Pointe du Grouin offers panoramas of Mont-Saint-Michel on clear days, hosts WWII blockhouses near the semaphore, and overlooks Île des Landes (~8 hectares) where cormorants and seabirds nest; grey seals occasionally rest on offshore rocks.
quote: Sur l'île des Landes, grands cormorans et goélands marins nichent paisiblement sur les parois rocheuses... environ 8 hectares... d'anciens blockhaus situés à proximité du sémaphore actuel

claim: Compagnie Corsaire's 2h30 commented cruise (boarding Saint-Malo 10:30 or Dinard 10:45, no disembarkation in Cancale) passes the Île des Landes bird sanctuary and Pointe du Grouin; adults €37, children 3-15 €24.40, under-3s €10.
quote: Durée 2h30... Saint-Malo 10:30... Dinard 10:45... Adulte 37€ Enfant (3-15 ans) 24,40€ Bébé (-3 ans) 10€

claim: Île des Landes is France's oldest biological nature reserve, founded in 1958 by SEPNB, and remains inaccessible to land visitors to protect nesting seabirds.
quote: L'île des Landes : l'Éden des oiseaux

claim: Le Coquillage in Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes earned its third Michelin star in the 2025 guide under Hugo Roellinger, having held two stars since 2019.
quote: Le Coquillage, la perle rare de Cancale, nouveau trois-Étoiles

claim: Olivier Roellinger did not sell the business; he retired from active kitchen duties in 2008 for health reasons and Hugo Roellinger has run Le Coquillage's kitchen since 2014, while sister Mathilde took over Épices Roellinger in 2018.
quote: Since 2014, Hugo has been elaborating his own cuisine with his crew at Coquillage... Olivier retired from active kitchen duties in 2008 for health reasons

claim: Grain de Vanille, the family's pastry shop-tea room at 12 place de la Victoire in upper Cancale, opens 9am-6:30pm continuously, closed Tuesdays, run by Yannick and Fernanda Gauthier since 2001 and selling Galettes Cancalaises, kouign-amann, ice creams and Roellinger spiced chocolates.
quote: Depuis 2001, Yannick et Fernanda Gauthier... 12, place de la Victoire 35260 CANCALE... ouvert en continu de 9h à 18h30, fermé le mardi

claim: Épices Roellinger's Cancale shop sits inside the Maison du Voyageur at 1 rue Duguesclin, doubling as the family's spice research and blending lab, with sister boutiques in Saint-Malo (12 rue Saint-Vincent) and Paris (51 bis rue Sainte-Anne).
quote: 1, rue Duguesclin – 35260 Cancale... Exotic scents waft through the kitchen lab, where spices from all over the world are roasted, oven-dried, ground, and then packaged

claim: The Maisons de Bricourt portfolio in Cancale also includes Les Rimains (clifftop 4-room hotel) and Gîtes Marins at 62 rue des Rimains, Le Bistrot de Cancale above Port Mer beach (opened June 2022), and La Cuisine Corsaire École cooking school on Place Saint-Méen.
quote: Les Rimains (62 rue des Rimains)... Le Bistrot de Cancale (5 Rue Eugène et Auguste Feyen) — New restaurant opened June 2022... La Cuisine Corsaire École (Place Saint-Méen)
